title: The Lighthouse Letters
correctedIdea: A burned-out nurse inherits her estranged father's lighthouse and finds letters from a woman he never mentioned.

synopsis.setup: Nora, a burned-out nurse, inherits a lighthouse from the father she stopped speaking to years ago. She plans to sell it and leave.
synopsis.complication: Inside, she finds letters to a woman he never mentioned. The woman's daughter, Mara, arrives with a claim on the property and a version of her father Nora never knew.
synopsis.resolution: Nora chooses to share the lighthouse and the truth, giving up the clean break she thought she wanted.

characters.name: Nora
characters.summary: A burned-out nurse who deflects emotion with logistics.

characters.name: Mara
characters.summary: The daughter of the woman in the letters, direct and unsentimental.

facts: Nora's father owned the lighthouse and never mentioned Mara's mother.
Nora is an only child.
The lighthouse is on a remote cliff and the ferry leaves at dawn.
Mara arrives with a tin of letters that matches Nora's.

scene.heading: INT. LIGHTHOUSE KITCHEN - NIGHT
scene.summary: Nora finds letters addressed to a woman she has never heard of and hides them when Mara knocks.

elements.text: Nora sets a rusted tin of letters on the kitchen table. The lighthouse beam sweeps the wall.
A knock lands on the door. She slides the letters under a plate.
NORA
Nobody's home.

title: Night Bus
correctedIdea: A night-shift bus driver gives a stranded teenager a ride home and recognizes the street where his own son used to live.

synopsis.setup: Ellis drives the 3:10 bus through an empty city. He has learned to prefer the quiet.
synopsis.complication: Jo, a teenager with no fare, gets on at the last stop. Ellis breaks the rules to drive her home, and the route passes Marlow Street.
synopsis.resolution: Ellis tells Jo one true thing about his son, then finishes the route with the radio off.

characters.name: Ellis
characters.summary: A night bus driver who has made a religion of routine.

characters.name: Jo
characters.summary: A stranded teenager who is too proud to ask for help directly.

facts: Ellis drives the 3:10 bus.
Jo missed the last bus and has no fare.
Ellis's son died two years ago.
The route passes Marlow Street.
Ellis has not spoken about his son to anyone at work.

scene.heading: INT. CITY BUS - NIGHT
scene.summary: Jo gets on without fare. Ellis lets the bus idle while the empty street waits, and Marlow Street comes up on the route.

elements.text: Rain films the bus windows. Jo stands by the fare box, counting coins that are not there.
ELLIS
You getting on, or just decorating the doorway?

title: Last Shift
correctedIdea: A kitchen porter on his final shift finds a wedding ring in the dishwasher and must decide whether to report it before the restaurant closes.

synopsis.setup: Pavel has one shift left before he leaves the restaurant for good. He needs Rosa's reference and cannot afford a mistake.
synopsis.complication: A wedding ring comes out of the dishwasher. Reporting it means admitting he opened the machine; keeping it means carrying someone else's marriage out the door.
synopsis.resolution: Pavel returns the ring to the bride but tells Rosa the truth, and she writes the reference anyway.

characters.name: Pavel
characters.summary: A kitchen porter who is careful because careful is all he has left.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.summary: The manager, brisk and fair, who notices more than she says.

facts: Pavel quits tomorrow.
The ring belongs to a bride from table 9.
The restaurant closes in one hour.
Pavel needs Rosa's reference.
The dishwasher was not supposed to be running.

scene.heading: INT. RESTAURANT KITCHEN - NIGHT
scene.summary: Pavel finds the ring in the dishwasher as the kitchen closes around him, and Rosa asks why the machine is running.

elements.text: Steam pours from the dishwasher. Pavel reaches into the cutlery basket and comes out with a gold ring.
ROSA
Why is that machine on?

title: Rooftop Garden
correctedIdea: Two neighbors who have never spoken build a rooftop garden during a heatwave and discover they are fighting the same eviction.

synopsis.setup: Lena waters a single tomato plant on a forbidden rooftop. Mr. Okafor has been growing things up there for years without telling anyone.
synopsis.complication: The building is being sold. Their landlord's eviction notice is already taped inside the lobby, and the garden is the only thing either of them can control.
synopsis.resolution: They bring the garden down to the street as a public protest, turning a private refuge into a shared claim on the building.

characters.name: Lena
characters.summary: A tenant who is stubborn in small, practical ways.

characters.name: Mr. Okafor
characters.summary: A long-time resident who has been quietly breaking the rooftop rule for decades.

facts: The building is being sold.
The rooftop is forbidden by the lease.
It is day 12 of a heatwave.
Lena grows tomatoes.
Mr. Okafor has lived in the building for 30 years.
An eviction notice is taped inside the lobby.

scene.heading: EXT. APARTMENT ROOFTOP - DUSK
scene.summary: Lena finds Mr. Okafor watering tomatoes on the forbidden roof and realizes he has seen the eviction notice too.

elements.text: Heat rises off the tar paper. Mr. Okafor waters a row of tomato plants in old paint buckets.
LENA
How long have you been doing this?

forbiddenMentions: the building was sold last year

title: The Collector
correctedIdea: A small-time debt collector visits a bakery to collect from a woman who once helped him, and his boss is listening on the phone.

synopsis.setup: Cal collects protection money for Voss. He is good at it because he is afraid of Voss.
synopsis.complication: His next stop is Ines's bakery. Ines gave Cal his first job years ago, and Voss is listening on speakerphone while Cal asks her for money.
synopsis.resolution: Cal lies to Voss about the amount, pays the shortfall himself, and leaves the bakery with Ines's silence between them.

characters.name: Cal
characters.summary: A debt collector who survives by making himself smaller than the room.

characters.name: Ines
characters.summary: A baker who once gave Cal a chance and has not forgotten it.

characters.name: Voss
characters.summary: Cal's boss, present only as a voice on the phone.

facts: Cal owes Voss money.
Ines gave Cal a job years ago.
The bakery is behind on protection payments.
Voss records calls.
Cal is collecting in person while Voss listens on speakerphone.

scene.heading: INT. BAKERY - AFTERNOON
scene.summary: Cal arrives to collect from Ines while Voss listens on the phone, and the smell of bread makes the threat feel worse.

elements.text: The phone lies face up on the counter, call timer running. Ines slides a tray of rolls into the display case.
CAL
You know why I'm here.

title: The Best Man's Speech
correctedIdea: A best man improvises a speech after discovering the groom's secret is printed on the back of his notes.

synopsis.setup: Denny has prepared a safe, funny speech for Marcus and Priya's wedding. He wants to get through it without revealing how much he will miss his friend.
synopsis.complication: On the back of his notes is Marcus's private plan to quit his job and open a bakery. Priya has not been told.
synopsis.resolution: Denny folds the notes away and gives a speech about change that lets Marcus choose when to tell her.

characters.name: Denny
characters.summary: The best man, funny in crowds and terrified of sincerity.

characters.name: Priya
characters.summary: The bride, a surgeon with a low tolerance for nonsense.

characters.name: Marcus
characters.summary: The groom, who fears public speaking and change in equal measure.

facts: Denny is the best man.
Marcus has a fear of public speaking.
Priya is a surgeon.
The wedding is at a vineyard.
Marcus is quitting his job to open a bakery.
Priya does not know about the bakery yet.

scene.heading: INT. VINEYARD TENT - EVENING
scene.summary: Denny stands up to give the speech, sees the bakery plan on the back of his notes, and has to decide what not to say.

elements.text: Denny taps his glass. The tent quiets. He sees writing on the back of his notes that is not his.
DENNY
I had a whole speech. Then I reread my notes.

title: Signal Lost
correctedIdea: A radio operator at a remote Antarctic station hears a voice on a dead frequency that claims to be her own.

synopsis.setup: Wren has been alone at the station for 40 days. The radio has been dead since the storm took the antenna.
synopsis.complication: Tonight the radio speaks. The voice knows Wren's childhood nickname and describes the room behind her.
synopsis.resolution: Wren answers the voice, and the station's lights go out one room at a time.

characters.name: Wren
characters.summary: A radio operator who trusts equipment more than people.

characters.name: The Voice
characters.summary: A presence on the dead frequency that sounds exactly like Wren.

facts: The station has been cut off for 40 days.
Wren is the only one awake.
The radio was dead before tonight.
The voice knows Wren's childhood nickname.
The storm took the antenna.

scene.heading: INT. RADIO ROOM - NIGHT
scene.summary: The dead radio crackles with Wren's own voice, and the station lights begin to fail as she answers.

elements.text: Static fills the radio room. Wren's hand hovers over the transmit key.
WREN
Who is this?

title: The Inheritance
correctedIdea: A woman returns to her childhood home to settle her late mother's estate and finds her estranged brother already living there.

synopsis.setup: Ruth is the executor of her mother's estate. She has not spoken to her brother Simon in a year.
synopsis.complication: Simon has been living in the house since their mother died. He has changed the locks and wants to buy Ruth out.
synopsis.resolution: Ruth finds their mother's will in a drawer and learns the house was left to both of them, with one condition.

characters.name: Ruth
characters.summary: The executor, precise and unwilling to be made a fool of.

characters.name: Simon
characters.summary: The estranged brother, settled in the house and already defending it.

facts: Their mother died six weeks ago.
Simon has lived in the house for a year.
Ruth is the executor.
The house is in a coastal town.

Simon has changed the locks.

scene.heading: INT. FAMILY HOME - LIVING ROOM - DAY
scene.summary: Ruth arrives to inventory the house and finds Simon already living in it, with the locks changed and the will missing.

elements.text: Ruth's key does not fit the front door. Simon opens it from inside, holding a mug.

title: Sunday Gravy
correctedIdea: Three siblings argue over their late mother's sauce recipe while the pot burns on the stove.

synopsis.setup: Angela has cooked her mother's Sunday sauce every week since the funeral. Tony and Dee have come to help, or to divide the house.
synopsis.complication: No one wrote the recipe down. Tony wants to sell the house, Dee wants the recipe, and the pot starts to burn.
synopsis.resolution: They save the sauce together, badly, and agree to cook it again next Sunday.

characters.name: Angela
characters.summary: The eldest, who has made caretaking her whole personality.

characters.name: Tony
characters.summary: The brother who talks about the house when he means something else.

characters.name: Dee
characters.summary: The youngest, who remembers the recipe differently than anyone else.

facts: Their mother died last month.
The recipe was never written down.
Angela has cooked it every Sunday since.
Tony wants to sell the house.
The pot is burning.

scene.heading: INT. FAMILY KITCHEN - SUNDAY
scene.summary: The siblings argue over the recipe while smoke rises from the pot, and each of them remembers their mother differently.

elements.text: Smoke curls from the pot. Angela stirs harder, as if speed could fix the recipe.
TONY
She never wrote it down because she wanted us to need her.
